record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: For the Pollaczek polynomials considered in the paper, does the entropy asymptotic formula previously proved under stronger hypotheses remain valid even though these polynomials do not satisfy those earlier assumptions?

evidence.quote: As it follows from [2], for these polynomials E_n diverges. However, they do not satisfy the conditions of [18]. Is formula (5.1) still valid?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $w$ be the symmetric Pollaczek weight on the interval $[-1,1]$, namely
$$w(x)=\frac{1}{\pi}\,e^{(2\theta-\pi)a/\sin\theta}\,\bigl|\Gamma\bigl(\lambda+i\,a/\sin\theta\bigr)\bigr|^{2},\qquad x=\cos\theta,\ \theta\in(0,\pi),$$
with parameters $a\ge 0$ and $\lambda\ge 1$, and let $\{p_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the sequence of polynomials orthonormal with respect to $w$, so that $\int_{-1}^{1}p_n(x)p_m(x)w(x)\,dx=\delta_{nm}$.

Define the Shannon entropy of $p_n$ by
$$E_n \;=\; -\int_{-1}^{1} p_n(x)^2\,\log\!\bigl(p_n(x)^2\bigr)\,w(x)\,dx.$$

It is known that $w$ lies outside the Szegő class on $[-1,1]$, so the standard Szegő‐class hypotheses under which the asymptotic formula
$$E_n \;=\; \log(2\pi) - 1 - \int_{-1}^{1}\frac{\log w(x)}{\pi\sqrt{1-x^2}}\,dx + o(1)\qquad (n\to\infty) \tag{$\ast$}$$
has been established do not apply, and in fact $E_n\to -\infty$.

Question: Does the asymptotic relation $(\ast)$ — interpreted with its leading terms suitably normalized — nevertheless remain valid for the orthonormal symmetric Pollaczek polynomials, and if so, determine the first two terms in the asymptotic expansion of $E_n$ as $n\to\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The asymptotic behavior of the Shannon entropy of the orthonormal symmetric Pollaczek polynomials was established by Martínez-Finkelshtein, Sánchez-Lara and coauthors (arXiv:math/0504250, published in J. Approx. Theory, 2006). They computed the first two terms of the asymptotic expansion of the entropic integrals for the symmetric Pollaczek weight (which lies outside the Szegő class), confirming a universal asymptotic behavior beyond the Szegő-class hypotheses under which earlier formulas had been proved.

status_evidence.title: Shannon entropy of symmetric Pollaczek polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: For the symmetric Pollaczek weight on [-1,1] with main parameter lambda >= 1, the first two terms of the asymptotic expansion of the entropic integrals are obtained, showing universal behavior beyond the Szegő class.
status_evidence.claim: The entropy asymptotic formula for symmetric Pollaczek polynomials has been proved, despite the weight lying outside the Szegő class.

status_evidence.title: Shannon entropy of symmetric Pollaczek polynomials (ScienceDirect)
status_evidence.snippet: Published in Journal of Approximation Theory; establishes the first two asymptotic terms of the Shannon entropy for symmetric Pollaczek polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication confirming the asymptotic entropy formula for Pollaczek polynomials.
